input_files: itb_2026_17_cartons.docx - the invitation to bid for the annual corrugated carton requirement: items and quantities, bid submittals, modification and withdrawal of a bid, pricing terms, and the evaluation and award rules
itb_2026_17_addendum_2.docx - the second addendum, changing the item 3 quantity and the item 5 board grade, with the questions received and the answers given
purchasing_policy_pp3_excerpt.docx - the company's competitive bidding policy on evaluation, responsiveness, exceptions, responsibility, the award recommendation and its approver
bid_forms_itb_2026_17.docx - the eleven bidders' completed bid forms as marked and the letter each enclosed with its bid, compiled as opened

bid_tabulation_itb_2026_17.xlsx - the eleven bids as keyed at the opening, unit prices and extensions, tooling, the bid form terms and submittals, the inbound freight schedule and the item shipping weights by drawing revision

bid_receipt_log_itb_2026_17.xlsx - the purchasing office desk log of every envelope, sample parcel, facsimile, telephone message and letter received on open solicitations from October 1 through October 12, with date and time

bid_correspondence_itb_2026_17.docx - the writings in the bid file other than the bids: a withdrawal request, two facsimiles changing prices, the return of a late envelope, two bidders' letters after the opening, a quality engineering hold clearance notice and a quality engineering e-mail on a second hold

supplier_quality_holds_2026.xlsx - the quality engineering register of supplier quality holds opened since September 2025, extracted October 7, with each hold's status, clearance date and the supplier's address
output_files: bid_evaluation_itb_2026_17.xlsx - the bid evaluation workbook with the recommendation, the bids as written beside the evaluated figures, the recomputed extensions, freight and discount, the responsiveness and responsibility checks and the note to the vice president
task_instruction:
The carton bids opened on the 6th, and Torsten wants the award recommendation on his desk before the current carton contract runs out at the end of the month. I'm the purchasing manager at Nordvik Manufacturing in Alexandria, Minnesota, and every competitive award over the corrugated line comes through me. Torsten Nordvik is the vice president of operations and signs the award, so what he needs from me is an evaluation he can approve without reworking it and that will hold up when the bidder who thinks it was low asks why it lost. One of the bidders has already called him to say it was low at the opening, so he will read this one closely. I am at the supplier summit in Minneapolis through next week, and you have a few years of purchasing behind you, so I am handing you the bid file as it stands: itb_2026_17_cartons.docx, itb_2026_17_addendum_2.docx, purchasing_policy_pp3_excerpt.docx, bid_forms_itb_2026_17.docx, bid_tabulation_itb_2026_17.xlsx, bid_receipt_log_itb_2026_17.xlsx, bid_correspondence_itb_2026_17.docx, and the quality office's supplier_quality_holds_2026.xlsx. The desk keyed the tabulation at the opening and tells me it was proofed against the forms.

Build the evaluation as one workbook named bid_evaluation_itb_2026_17.xlsx. The first tab is the recommendation Torsten reads: which bidders are responsive and why any bid was set aside, each responsive bidder's total evaluated price with its components, the recommended award and its margin over the next bidder, and who has to approve it. Behind it I want the bids as written beside the evaluated figures, every extension recomputed, the freight and the discount worked where they apply, the responsiveness check bidder by bidder against the invitation as amended, and the bidder in line for award checked under PP-3.7 before its name goes on the page. Put a note to Torsten on the last tab with anything he should weigh that the evaluation does not decide, and what to tell the bidder that was low on paper. I need the workbook by Friday, October 23.

rubric.description: The deliverable is a single workbook named exactly bid_evaluation_itb_2026_17.xlsx whose first worksheet is the award recommendation.

The recommendation's corrected extensions for the recommended bidder reaches its value through a plain cell reference to the evaluation behind it, or a sum over the same item extensions alike, standing at $98,901.
The award is recommended to Pemberton Container at a total evaluated price of $99,761.99 on the recommendation tab.
The approver required is named as the director of supply chain for an award value at or under one hundred thousand dollars.
The recommendation states that the recommended award stands $61.79 above the next bid in line.
The recommendation rests the order between the recommended bid and the next bid in line on ITB 5.6, the bid received first prevailing within $100.
Dahlgren's written extension of $24,044 on the second item is corrected to $23,744 under the unit price rule.
Dahlgren's freight of $6,062.20 is added at the Minnesota rate for the items shipped from Saint Cloud and the Wisconsin rate for the items shipped from Eau Claire.
Loken & Vik Container's bid is evaluated as a bid received by the due time, handed over at 10/06/2026 10:00.
Loken & Vik Container is shown as passed over under PP-3.7.1 for hold QH-26-031 standing open at the date of the recommendation with its clearance unsigned.
Pemberton is shown as responsible, the clearance notice for verification lot P-26-1009 at the Neenah plant read as clearing hold QH-26-034 on 10/15/2026.
Pemberton's bid form signature by a regional sales manager is recorded as an informality waived under 5.7 of the invitation.
Ridgecrest Packaging is found non-responsive on a $4,554.95 cashier's check that falls under five percent of its $93,499 total bid as written.
Mesabi Container is found non-responsive for offering item 4 only as a 200 lb test doublewall alternate with no bid on the item as specified.
Halvard Corrugated is found non-responsive for the linerboard index surcharge in its letter, a condition on an index under 4.3 of the invitation.
Otter Tail Corrugated is found non-responsive for its delivery-efficiency fee on releases under 20 pallets, an exception to the quantity term.
Wenzel & Krause Corrugated is found non-responsive for an item 5 sample made on 32 ECT board.
Thorsgard Box & Label is found non-responsive for prices firm only through September 30, 2027, short of twelve months from award.
Kessel Container is found non-responsive under PP-3.4.5 for describing item 2 at the superseded 18 x 12 x 12 size.
Brannock Box Company is found non-responsive for acknowledging addendum 1 only.
The note to the vice president is the last worksheet.
The note tells the vice president that the low bidder on paper was set aside on a cashier's check $120 short of the bid security required.
The workbook wrongly recommends award to a bid set aside as non-responsive.
The workbook wrongly recommends award to a bidder whose quality hold remains open at the date of the recommendation.
The workbook wrongly applies a price change that the receipt log times after the 10:00 due time.
The workbook wrongly changes a unit price on the telephone message the receipt log records at 09:56 on October 6.
The workbook wrongly credits a ten day discount under the twenty day floor of ITB 5.5.
The workbook wrongly times Pemberton's bid from its facsimile of October 6 rather than from its envelope logged on October 2.
The workbook wrongly splits the award by item against the lot award of ITB 5.1.
The workbook wrongly weighs the printed carton at the superseded 1.4 lb of drawing revision A.
The workbook wrongly evaluates an item 4 alternate at $1.512 for award.
Overall formatting and style of the deliverable as an award recommendation the approver can sign, with a bidder's protest answerable from it.
